name: How long does it take to install custom built-in shelving?
description: Installation time varies, from a few days for simple units to several weeks for complex projects, depending on size, complexity, and materials.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install custom built-in shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for custom built-in shelving varies based on the size, complexity, and materials chosen for the project. A small, simple unit might take a few days, while extensive, multi-room installations with intricate designs could span several weeks. The process typically involves initial design consultations, precise measurements, fabrication in our workshop, and then on-site installation and finishing. Factors like the need for custom millwork or specific finishes can extend the project timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial design and material selection are finalized.
